adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(glm CONFIG REQUIRED) and links glm::glm; its headers are included as <glm/glm.hpp> and <glm/gtc/quaternion.hpp>.
GLM_FORCE_* defines change GLM's types and conventions for every translation unit that sees them: a composition that wants one sets it on automap_glue in this fragment, where the adapters see it too.
